title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I hate that my momentum has shifted this way
If the union gets me my beat back, which they’re very confident in, I have to come back, don’t I
I don’t think I can pass up on that opportunity to walk back in there
“Hello Ron”
I think they’re a little bit more confident than they should be, though.
There is no chance in hell I would let me cover the Tigers again if I were them
No. Chance.
The Tigers lost, but apparently my pet snake Ronny got out of his cage and I’m really more concerned about that right now.
Wait, is there a deeper joke there I’m missing?
Yes
But nobody would get it if you don’t
Except █████████████, he’d get it
I’m not doing it. And I’m kinda bummed because I for a fleeting hour there, I was too excited about the grand finale
By doing it, I mean tweeting up a storm like I was before
So if I’m not gonna do that, I’m not going back on the Tigers
I talked to Elrick for a while today. He’s that kinda guy.... But it was dumb. I put this other story at risk
After sending the Tigers pizza and getting disciplined, it’s gonna take some convincing to be like “hey hi can I do this story to pound the Tigers again?”
Well shit. So all this work is wasted?
No
But all he was saying is basically be careful because I’m def in the doghouse
And that’s not usually the time when they’re like ok, go run free pony boy
Right. You have to hit send on that story once the season is done at the earliest haha
Yeah
How’s it going
Busy as usual. I’m telling ya, this shit ain’t gonna fly very long.
If it doesn’t, it doesn’t, but I still think you should give yourself a shot before you do decide to leave
